description.from: Compose the reusable deployment-specific command worker from the shared lifecycle, delivery adapter, durable state, and container platform interfaces. Preserve provider-neutral command semantics; keep dashboard integration and deployment-specific wiring outside the core command-worker package. Verify lifecycle resources, worker permissions, deployment health, and an end-to-end command path without consumer-specific configuration.
description.to: Compose and validate the Plexus-owned command-service companion deployment from the existing portable lifecycle, Celery delivery adapter, durable state, container artifact, and always-on worker constructs. Keep it outside the Amplify stacks and the legacy mixed infrastructure application. Require a complete dashboard submission, execution, projection, and deployment proof before it is eligible for main.
